scope.actuator: Long fractional UPRO for bullish or SPXU for bearish

frozen_signal.asia_cohort: prior calendar day 16:00 through signal day 00:59; exactly eighteen 30-minute spot bars
frozen_signal.europe_cohort: signal day 01:00 through 08:59; exactly sixteen 30-minute spot bars
frozen_signal.no_trade: opposite signs, an exact zero, or incomplete cohort

execution.baseline_cost: full observed bid-ask spread at both fills
execution.cost_stress: one additional cent per share adverse at entry and exit

mechanism_contrasts.sign_flipped: trade the exact opposite UPRO/SPXU direction on every actual-signal date
mechanism_contrasts.btc_price_persistence: trade only when Asia and Europe BTC spot price returns have the same sign; use that sign
mechanism_contrasts.europe_flow_only: trade the sign of Europe cohort taker-flow imbalance without requiring the Asia baton

prohibited_after_results: change New York time to a fitted UTC clock
add an imbalance magnitude, BTC return, volatility, weekday, month, year, or ETF-spread filter
combine V26 with a prior candidate based on historical P&L
open holdout after any development-gate failure
evidence_warning: The broader equity history is familywise contaminated by prior research. A historical survivor would remain a paper candidate requiring new forward validation.
